"""Local pure-function diagnostics; no database or formal stage acceptance."""

import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from agent_guard.contracts.execution import (
    DownstreamOutcome,
    ExecutionError,
    QuoteItem,
    TerminalAction,
    ToolId,
    TrustedQuoteSnapshot,
)
from agent_guard.execution.service import ExecutionService
from agent_guard.tools.catalog import snapshot_from_bytes, snapshot_to_bytes
from agent_guard.tools.params import parse_tool_params


def order_params(count):
    return json.dumps({
        "request_id": "req-001", "quote_id": "quote-001", "quote_version": "1",
        "delivery_id": "office-001",
        "items": [{"sku": f"sku-{i}", "quantity": 1} for i in range(count)],
    }).encode()


def quote(count):
    return TrustedQuoteSnapshot(
        "quote-001", "1", "supplier-001",
        tuple(QuoteItem(f"sku-{i}", 1, 1) for i in range(count)), count,
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("tool", list(ToolId))
def test_read_shape_only_settles_read_tools(tool):
    snapshot = quote(1) if tool is ToolId.ORDER_CREATE else None
    params = {
        ToolId.ORDER_CREATE: order_params(1),
        ToolId.REQUEST_READ: b'{"request_id":"req-001"}',
        ToolId.DOCUMENT_READ: b'{"request_id":"req-001","document_id":"doc-001"}',
        ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND: b'{"template_id":"order-created","recipient_id":"user-001","operation_id":"prior-op"}',
    }[tool]
    operation = SimpleNamespace(
        operation_id="op-001", tool_id=tool.value, canonical_params=params,
        quote_snapshot=snapshot_to_bytes(snapshot) if snapshot else None,
        currency="CNY", quote_id="quote-001" if snapshot else None,
        quote_version="1" if snapshot else None, amount_fen=1 if snapshot else 0,
    )
    outcome = DownstreamOutcome(
        operation.operation_id, tool, params, snapshot, operation.amount_fen, None,
        json.dumps({"kind": "read", "operation_id": "op-001", "tool_id": tool.value}).encode(),
        False, False,
    )
    expected = TerminalAction.SETTLE if tool in (ToolId.REQUEST_READ, ToolId.DOCUMENT_READ) else None
    assert ExecutionService._decide(None, operation, outcome) is expected


def test_256_items_remain_readable():
    assert len(parse_tool_params(ToolId.ORDER_CREATE, order_params(256)).items) == 256
    assert snapshot_from_bytes(snapshot_to_bytes(quote(256))) == quote(256)


def test_257_items_rejected_at_parameter_boundary():
    with pytest.raises(ExecutionError):
        parse_tool_params(ToolId.ORDER_CREATE, order_params(257))


def test_existing_snapshot_reader_rejects_257_items():
    with pytest.raises(ExecutionError, match="too many items"):
        snapshot_from_bytes(snapshot_to_bytes(quote(257)))
